name: Simplex Method
when_to_use: Solving a Linear Programming (LP) problem with more than two variables, seeking the optimal solution.

expected_input.question: What is the optimal solution of a linear programming problem?

pdca_use: Plan phase: solve the resource allocation formulated as Linear Programming with a reproducible optimal solution (same problem, same answer every time).

plain_explanation.purpose: Procedure that solves linear programming problems by moving from corner to corner until reaching the best one.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: To solve by hand or to understand how the solver works.
plain_explanation.data_needed: The same inputs as linear programming: goal, limits and coefficients.
plain_explanation.example: Solve a lowest-cost ingredient mix plan.
plain_explanation.diagram: corner 1 -> better neighboring corner -> ... -> optimal corner

notes: Shiny app; requires the lpSolve, lpSolveAPI, shiny, readxl and writexl R packages.
